::: {.section-light}
### Summer
95–105°F
Hot and humid from roughly June through September. Air conditioning runs nearly nonstop, and electricity bills can rise substantially.
### Fall
Best Weather
October and November usually bring warm days, cooler nights, and lower humidity. Generally the most pleasant time of year.
### Winter
40s–60s°F
Usually mild but unpredictable. Ice storms or hard freezes can shut down roads and schools. Keep a coat and blanket in your car.
### Spring
Storm Season
Spring is beautiful but volatile. Severe thunderstorms and tornadoes are possible, so keep weather alerts enabled.
::: ::: {.section-dark} # Driver's License & Vehicle Registration Texas gives new residents firm deadlines. The recommended order is: 1. Complete your emissions inspection 2. Register your vehicle 3. Update your insurance 4. Get your Texas driver's license ## Within 30 Days ### Register Your Vehicle Register your vehicle at the county tax assessor-collector's office. Bring: - Out-of-state title - Proof of Texas insurance - Photo ID ### Complete an Emissions Inspection Dallas County requires an annual emissions inspection before registration. ## Within 90 Days ### Get a Texas Driver's License Bring: - Proof of identity - Social Security number - Two proofs of Texas residency ::: ::: {.section-light} # Texas Auto Insurance | Coverage | Minimum | |---|---:| | Bodily injury per person | $30,000 | | Bodily injury per accident | $60,000 | | Property damage | $25,000 | Texas minimum liability coverage is commonly referred to as **30/60/25**. ::: {.callout-tip} Before registering your vehicle, verify that your insurance policy meets Texas minimum requirements. ::: ## Register to Vote (Optional) You can register to vote while obtaining your Texas driver's license or afterward through the Texas voter registration process. :::
